extraction_caveats:
1. The maintenance schedule uses non-uniform mileage intervals (7,500 / 10,000 / 15,000 / 18,000 / 20,000 / 22,500 / 25,000 / 30,000 etc.) with two time-based tracks (standard months and severe months) at the same mileage. Items are recorded with their base repeat interval where determinable; the full schedule is complex and the notes fields capture the actual checkpoint pattern.
2. Pages 549–550 (covering approximately 67,500–70,000 mi checkpoints) and page 560–563 (covering approximately 117,500–120,000 mi) were not provided; those intervals may contain additional items not captured here.
3. The 'interval_miles' and 'interval_months' for engine oil/filter are set to 5,000/null as a conservative representation since the schedule shows oil changes at every single checkpoint (both 7,500-mile standard and 5,000-mile severe intervals); the actual published intervals vary by checkpoint.
4. Tire rotation interval is listed as 7,500 mi / 6 months (standard schedule) based on the first occurrence; it recurs at most standard-schedule checkpoints.
5. Brake fluid is split into separate standard and severe entries. Standard interval is 30,000 mi/24 mo; severe first occurs at 10,000 mi/12 mo.
6. Transfer fluid capacity is not separately listed in the provided pages (page 564 table does not include transfer fluid capacity).
7. The ATF drain-and-refill capacity is listed as '—' (not specified) in the provided capacity table on page 564.
8. Engine valve clearance has no specific mileage interval in the schedule pages provided; it is condition-based (inspect only if valve noise increases).
9. Items marked with '*' in the manual are recommended by NISSAN for reliable vehicle operation but are not required to maintain emission warranty or manufacturer recall liability.
10. Differential gear oil and transfer fluid replacement only appear under severe-schedule essentials (20,000 mi/24 mo intervals at severe checkpoints), not under standard maintenance essentials. The standard schedule only inspects these fluids.
11. Engine coolant repeat interval is 75,000 mi/60 mo after first replacement at 105,000 mi/84 mo per page 557 footnote (2).
12. Differential gear oil capacities on page 564: Front row lists Non-XD 2-5/8 pt, XD 3-1/4 pt; Rear row lists Non-XD 4-7/8 pt, XD 5-1/2 pt.
